prompts.prompt: Create one photorealistic editorial photograph for an educational mobile hidden-detail game set in a fictional Hong Kong banking service desk. Portrait 4:5 composition, warm walnut wood, muted plum and cream palette, natural window light, restrained cinematic realism, believable small urban office, no real banks or logos, no watermark, no money, coins, currency amounts, percentages or price labels. A high three-quarter view of an uncluttered counter, with THREE LARGE well separated clue objects taking up most of the image and legible Traditional Chinese typography. At upper left a standing A5 purple-white placard reads exactly 「戶口核實」 and below in two bold lines 「點短訊連結」「登入處理」. At upper right a smartphone propped vertically on the desk shows a generic chat bubble in large Traditional Chinese exactly 「請截圖傳送」「一次性驗證碼」, no actual code, no visible URL. Across the bottom foreground an open clipboard visibly titled 「客戶登記」 with a few sample rows 「陳例子　示例電話」「李例子　示例電話」, no actual numbers, clearly exposed to visitors. Backdrop softly out of focus: frosted glass, anonymous empty chairs and muted Hong Kong tower windows. A pen and a small green plant serve as harmless details. The THREE TEXT AREAS must be exceptionally clear and big, physically printed or on the phone in the photograph. No red warning symbols, no highlights/circles/arrows, no UI overlay, no collage. The picture itself must look like an immersive realistic scene to inspect. This is explicitly fictional financial-literacy education, not a real bank allegation.

Create one photorealistic editorial photograph for an educational mobile hidden-detail game: a fictional insurance consultation tabletop in Hong Kong. Portrait 4:5 composition, warm walnut and muted plum/cream colors, gentle natural light and cinematic but realistic fine textures. Match a premium Hong Kong finance educational site. No recognizable brand, actual insurer, money, currency, numeric premiums, percentages, watermarks. High three-quarter top-down angle with THREE LARGE, non-overlapping clue objects and accurate crisp Traditional Chinese print, taking up most of frame. Upper left a cream upright promotional booklet with a subtle umbrella image and headline exactly 「任何情況」「都有保障」. Upper right a purple tablet on a stand with a large message exactly 「只看摘要」「不用全文」 and small generic text lines underneath, no numbers. Lower foreground a wide white application sheet titled 「申請表」 with visibly empty fields and a pen, alongside a rectangular plum note printed exactly 「先簽空白表」「稍後補資料」. Each important text phrase needs to be very legible at mobile size, not tiny. Neutral teacup lower right and an out-of-focus plant are harmless details. Background of a quiet urban meeting area and Hong Kong apartments very softly blurred. No warning signs, red circles, highlighted clues, diagram or illustration. Three clearly separated objects in one coherent real-looking photograph. Fictional education on reading conditions, no actual insurance offer.

Create one portrait 4:5 photorealistic editorial lifestyle photograph for a fictional financial-information hidden-detail mobile game. High three-quarter view over a Hong Kong cafe table, warm walnut desk, muted plum, cream and slate, soft window light with distant dense Hong Kong buildings. THREE LARGE separate clue objects laid out clearly, with crisp and accurate Traditional Chinese typography readable on mobile. Upper-left a plain white flyer that reads exactly 「群組專屬消息」 then in bold 「唔好向外查證」. Upper-right a laptop screen angled toward camera displays a generic purple chat panel with the clear message 「刪走風險提示」「只轉發結論」. Lower foreground a smartphone displayed almost flat but fully readable shows a generic profile badge containing 「專家」 and the message 「有頭銜就可信」. No logos of real platforms, actual organizations, real people, no currency symbols or amounts, no share prices, no profit percentages, no banknotes or coins. A teacup and closed notebook are neutral background details. All three clue objects should occupy large non-overlapping areas, positioned for a user to tap them in a hidden-detail game. No arrows, circles, warning icons, captions, split panels, illustration or hand-drawn features. Editorial photographic realism, consistently premium but understated. Explicitly fictional learning material, never a real financial offer.
